info.name: Member 3 - Project & Team Service
info.description:
End-to-end Postman collection for the Project & Team Service (Member 3's scope): Project CRUD, Project Member Management, Project Required Skills, and the Member Recommendation Engine. All requests go through the API Gateway on {{baseUrl}} (default http://localhost:8080). Folders 01-02 are prerequisite setup in Auth Service and User & Skill Service, required only because Project & Team Service depends on identities and skill data owned by those services. Run folders in numeric order top-to-bottom (Postman Collection Runner) for a full, repeatable end-to-end pass. Folder 10 is destructive (removes/deletes the demo data) and is deliberately last so it never breaks an earlier folder.

IMPORTANT MANUAL STEP: after 'Register PM' in folder 01 and before 'Login PM', promote that account to PROJECT_MANAGER directly in the Auth Service database (no API does this):

UPDATE auth_users SET role = 'PROJECT_MANAGER' WHERE email = '{{pmEmail}}';

(run against the skillteam_auth database). Every PROJECT_MANAGER-only request in this collection will return 403 until this step is done.

item.name: 01 - Auth Setup (Prerequisite)
item.description: Registers and logs in three Auth Service accounts: one to be manually promoted to PROJECT_MANAGER (see collection description), and two regular USER accounts that will become project members. Captures {{pmToken}}/{{pmId}}, {{member1Token}}/{{member1Id}}, {{member2Token}}/{{member2Id}} for every later request.

request.description: Registers the account that will be manually promoted to PROJECT_MANAGER before it logs in.

exec: pm.test('Role is PROJECT_MANAGER (fails if the manual DB promotion step was skipped)', () => pm.expect(body.user.role).to.eql('PROJECT_MANAGER'));

request.description: Run this only AFTER manually promoting this account to PROJECT_MANAGER in the skillteam_auth database (see collection description). The JWT role claim is fixed at login time.

item.name: 02 - User & Skill Service Setup (Prerequisite)
item.description: Creates the skill catalog and each member's own profile/skills. Deliberately gives Member 1 both skills at a high level and Member 2 only one skill at a low level, so the recommendation demo in folder 09 shows a clear, contrasting ranking (100% vs 0%).

request.description: Member 2 deliberately has no Java skill at all, and SQL only at BEGINNER (below the project's INTERMEDIATE requirement) — this is what produces the 0% match in the recommendation demo.
Any authenticated role (USER or PROJECT_MANAGER) can list/view projects — this is a read-only endpoint.

exec: pm.test('Error message present', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql('A project with this name already exists.'));

item.name: Add Required Skill - Invalid Proficiency Literal (400)

request.description: 'MASTER' is not a valid ProficiencyLevel enum literal (BEGINNER, INTERMEDIATE, ADVANCED, EXPERT) — Jackson rejects it during deserialization.
The centerpiece of the demo: Member 1 (Java EXPERT + SQL INTERMEDIATE) fully satisfies both required skills; Member 2 (SQL BEGINNER only, below the INTERMEDIATE bar, no Java) satisfies neither.

item.name: Get Recommendations - User & Skill Service Down (MANUAL, 503)

exec: console.warn('Skipping strict assertion: this request only returns 503 if the User & Skill Service has been manually stopped first. Current status: ' + pm.response.code);

request.description: MANUAL STEP REQUIRED: stop the User & Skill Service process before running this request to observe the fail-fast 503 behavior. If User & Skill Service is still running, this will return 200 like the happy-path request above — that is expected, not a failure of this test.

item.name: 10 - Cleanup and Destructive Tests (Run Last)
item.description: Removes and deletes the demo data created above, and re-exercises the same operations to confirm they now 404. Deliberately placed last so running the whole collection top-to-bottom never breaks an earlier folder.
